lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p11 - Listen, point and say.

details: Listen, point and say checks understanding of word meaning and sound and reinforces blending and segmenting skills. Listen and point shows they match what they hear to the right image. Say practises blending sounds together to make words.
Look for careful listening, correct pointing, clear sounds and accurate blending, and confident repetition.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p11 - Match. Trace and write.

details: Match strengthens first-sound awareness by having students identify the initial phoneme, connect it to the correct letter, and demonstrate early phonics control by linking each sound to a picture that begins with it. Trace and write gives students controlled practice writing individual letters. It reinforces letter formation, and neat handwriting.
Look for accurate pronunciation of the sound, correct identification of the pictures, correct isolation of their first sound, and consistent letter formation.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p59 - Colour and say.

details: Colour and say develops first sound identification. Students say the words, isolate the first sounds and colour the letter that corresponds to that sound.

Look for correct identification of the target words and correct isolation of their first sounds, accurate choosing of the letter that corresponds to that first sound, and careful colouring of the box.
